summary: Comprehensive testing of Jucăuș Magazine (Romanian interactive editorial blog). Backend: 9/9 pytest tests passing — posts CRUD (list, category filter, featured filter, slug lookup, 404), categories endpoint, newsletter (valid, duplicate, invalid). Frontend: Home loads, hero renders, all 6 category filters (filter-toate/arhitectură/artă/cultură/design/modă) present and functional (filtering Artă reduced grid to 2 correct cards), all 6 article-card-<slug> testids render, article page navigation works (/articol/manifestul-culorii shows h1, cover image, body), newsletter form submits and shows sonner toast 'Bine ai venit în club!', all nav testids present (nav-povești, nav-manifest, nav-rubrici, nav-subscribe). No console errors, no page errors. Lenis smooth scroll works via window.__lenis.

issues: Browser tab title is generic 'Emergent | Fullstack App' — should be updated to 'Jucăuș' branding in public/index.html for polish

action_items: (Optional) Update public/index.html <title> to 'Jucăuș — Revista culturii vizuale' to match brand
(Optional/minor) Lenis warning: ensure scroll container has non-static position (already visually fine; cosmetic warning only)
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: logger is used inside seed_db before logger is initialized (logging.basicConfig runs after startup event registration). Startup log message may fail silently or use uninitialized name — move logger init above @app.on_event('startup'). Currently no impact because seeding is idempotent, but it is a latent bug.

server.py CORS: allow_credentials=True combined with allow_origins='*' (default) is invalid per CORS spec and will be rejected by browsers when credentials are used. Not blocking current app (no auth) but should be tightened.
No pagination on /api/posts (fine for 6 items but doesn't scale).
test_credentials: N/A - no auth in this app
seed_data_creation: None (backend auto-seeds 6 posts on startup); newsletter tests create unique test_<uuid>@example.com subscribers
context_for_next_testing_agent: All primary flows verified. If retesting, use window.__lenis.scrollTo() (not window.scrollTo) for programmatic scroll because Lenis uses transform-based scrolling. Category filter testids use lowercase Romanian slugs (filter-artă with diacritic). Backend at REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL, all endpoints under /api.
